Recovery Process

From client follow-up to Head Office review
▾
1 · HO extractsAll open invoices with a due balance load straight from the ERP into this sheet, branch-wise.
2 · Branch calls the clientCounsellor and manager call every client on their list and record what actually happened.
3 · Manager updatesPick a status, then fill only the boxes that open up. Reason is compulsory for anything not collectable.
4 · Auto-saved to ERPEach update writes to the ERP instantly — no file to mail. HO sees it live.
5 · HO reviewsHO checks every "not collectable" line with the reason and the manager name before approving.
6 · ERP clean-upApproved lines are written off, collections are receipted, and the balance left is the real recoverable due.
